messages:
Ivy (PM): Quick sync — we need a prioritization rubric for routing/isolation experiments. Goal: pick one Q3 pilot + explicit launch/rollback gates. Keep replies short.

Priya (Arch): Proposals: strict-sla lane (tight p99), low-cost lane (aggressive batching), residence pockets (region-pin + audits). Tradeoffs: cache boundaries, cross-region state, and operator blast radius.

Jo (Eng): Runtime note: strict-sla needs per-tenant cache namespaces and batch window ~35-50ms. Low-cost prefers batch windows 150-220ms and shared caching. Residence pockets require KMS + exportable audit events.

Chen (SRE): Ops: limit pilot to <6% fleet. Must have automated drain and canary rollback. Ops gates: drain success >=95%, regional failover RTO <= 180s.

Naomi (Sales): Sales signals: residency + SLA frequently asked. If we choose strict-sla, run a parallel residency discovery so we don't lose pipeline.

Rahul (CS): Customer example: bank wants region-pin + 99.95% p99 + 30d audit export. Onboarding templates cut pilot time.

Ivy (PM): Ask: each owner add 1 quality gate + 1 ops gate (numeric). I'll assemble a short decision grid.

Priya (Arch): Quality gate: tenant p99 <= 150ms. Ops gate: cross-tenant tail amplification < 6% at 99th.

Jo (Eng): Quality gate: KV hit >= 60% for strict-sla lane (24h avg). Ops gate: median batch wait <= 40ms.

Chen (SRE): Ops gate: automated drain success >=95% on canary. Ops gate 2: regional failover RTO <= 180s.

Naomi (Sales): GTM gate: residency discovery doc + audit export verified. Sales gate: 1 paid pilot or legal pre-approval.

Rahul (CS): Customer gate: onboarding <= 10 business days using templates. Rollback gate: any two numeric gates breached for 24h OR customer-visible error rate >0.5% for 1h.

Ivy (PM): Draft decision grid (weights in parentheses):
- Performance lane: p99/p50 weight (0.4), ops risk (0.3), cost delta (0.3)
- Cost lane: cost (0.5), ops (0.2), quality delta (0.3)
- Residency: compliance (0.5), ops (0.3), cost (0.2)

Ivy (PM): Quick vote: react :one: performance lane, :two: cost lane, :three: residency pockets. Vote by EOD Wed.

Priya (Arch): :one:
Jo (Eng): :one: (iterate residency later)
Chen (SRE): :one:
Naomi (Sales): :three: (will support if discovery prioritized)
Rahul (CS): :one:

Ivy (PM): Leaning performance lane pilot with residency discovery track. I'll draft a one-pager + acceptance checklist tomorrow. Thanks :raised_hands:
